The neighbours downstairs have a dog that howls whenever anyone plays the piano, which is often. Could you note that I promised to bring back milk and bread on the way home tomorrow? I forgot twice already and I'd rather not hear about it a third time.
Also, my shoes need mending — the left one is letting in water. Find me a cobbler nearby, preferably one who doesn't talk politics for an hour while measuring.
